note: F1 catalog provenance plus textual donor claims only. MAKNUM/MUNKAM are historical live-process handles, not persistent addresses or current physical encoding. THE matches published Common Lisp special operator law; no actual donor-oracle parity claimed. D10 candidate laws require independent F2/F3+owner review.

candidates.name: MAKNUM
candidates.law: map runtime object identity to positive integer, such that equal integer iff EQ identity; historically pointer or table-based, no portable persistent address guarantee
law_variants: map runtime object identity to positive integer, such that equal integer iff EQ identity; historically pointer or table-based, no portable persistent address guarantee
positive_witness_claims: two distinct EQ-nonidentical cons cells map to different live ids; identical object maps to same live id
negative_witness_claims: structural equality alone forces same identity id; id asserted stable after serialization/restart

candidates.name: MUNKAM
candidates.law: reverse a live object identity integer previously produced by MAKNUM; arbitrary/forged numbers are outside guaranteed contract
law_variants: reverse a live object identity integer previously produced by MAKNUM; arbitrary/forged numbers are outside guaranteed contract
positive_witness_claims: for a live x, MUNKAM(MAKNUM(x)) is EQ to x
negative_witness_claims: accept arbitrary forged handle as a valid object or claim stable cross-process object restoration

candidates.name: SPECIAL-BINDING
candidates.law: fixed SPECIAL cell used for dynamically visible free-variable communication; bind saves/restores prior value
law_variants: fixed SPECIAL cell used for dynamically visible free-variable communication; bind saves/restores prior value

candidates.name: THE
candidates.law: declaration of expected type(s) of expression result(s), preserving exact return value cardinality; mismatched types have undefined consequences, NOT mandated runtime check
law_variants: declaration of expected type(s) of expression result(s), preserving exact return value cardinality; mismatched types have undefined consequences, NOT mandated runtime check
positive_witness_claims: correctly typed two-result expression returns the same two values with declaration in place
negative_witness_claims: wrongly claim THE necessarily throws runtime type error for a violated declaration
